seo.metaTitle: JSON formatter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Check, tidy and minify JSON. The result updates as you type. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/json-format-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: JSON formatter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/json-format-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does JSON formatter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. JSON formatter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/json-format-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate JSON formatter?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/json_format.json or open /tools/json-format?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
